conclusion: At beta=40, n=89, both g6k SD-BKZ and BKZ reach FULL DSD (short=89=n, b1~1.96) across the entire q=211-521 range; SD-vs-BKZ advantage ~0 (|mean|<=0.015). No onset gap here -- the whole window is post-onset. The DSD-onset GAP (fplll: SD onset 237 < BKZ onset 281 at n=89) was a beta=20 result; the sieve needs beta>=40, where both engines crack DSD together. The gap-regime and the sieve-meaningful-beta do not overlap at n=89 -- a regime-constrained cross-engine result. The beta=40 onset edge is at LOWER q (Phase-4a: q=97 was sparse 2/20; q=211 here is full 89/89), to be swept next.
